text:
Kira Wong: opened PR #809 to add a CLI example and a short migration note for quota header renames. This touches pricing.md, quotas.md, and the grafana panel asset. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/809
Devon Park: thanks Kira. What's the final header set we're documenting? I saw multiple variants in other PRs.
Kira Wong: canonical headers for this change: `X-RW-Quota-Limit`, `X-RW-Quota-Remaining`, `X-RW-Quota-Window-UTC`. We'll keep the old `X-Quota-*` names for 7 days (short deprecation window).
Noah Feldman: short window noted. Can we include a curl + CLI snippet for ops folks that shows how to fetch remaining quota and fail gracefully?
Kira Wong: added two snippets in the PR. Curl snippet:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"status"}'
# check headers: X-RW-Quota-Remaining, X-RW-Quota-Limit
```
Kira Wong: and a tiny CLI (bash) example that exits with a friendly message when quota is low:
```bash
resp_headers=$(curl -sI -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate)
remaining=$(echo "$resp_headers" | grep -i "X-RW-Quota-Remaining" | awk -F": " '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
limit=$(echo "$resp_headers" | grep -i "X-RW-Quota-Limit" | awk -F": " '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$remaining" ]; then
  echo "Warning: quota header missing. Check gateway passthrough or CDN rules."
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$remaining" -lt 100 ]; then
  echo "Low quota: $remaining/$limit tokens left. Consider throttling clients."
fi
```
Riley Chen: nice. For the dashboard asset, the panel in the docs still referenced `quota_used_total`. Our exporter uses `rw_quota_consumed_total`. Can you update the panel JSON and the screenshot to match?
Kira Wong: yes, PR includes `/assets/grafana/panels/quota_consumption_rw.json` and a hi-res screenshot. I also added a footnote on the pricing page: "Headers: X-RW-Quota-* map to monthly allowance shown in the table."
Devon Park: small SDK note: Node and Python helpers lowercase header keys; added a one-line note about case-insensitivity and an example fallback: `resp.headers.get('x-rw-quota-remaining') || resp.headers.get('x-quota-remaining')`.
Noah Feldman: can we add a short troubleshooting bullet: "If `X-RW-Quota-Remaining` is 0 but the dashboard shows usage, check exporter label mismatch and sync metric name `rw_quota_consumed_total`."
Kira Wong: added that bullet under "Common issues". Also included a tiny migration diff snippet showing old->new header names and the 7-day deprecation note.
DocsBot: PR #809 status changed: reviewers requested @devon, @riley, @noah.
Devon Park: left one tiny suggestion to clarify the CLI script uses a HEAD vs GET request; suggestion pushed.
Riley Chen: approved (panel JSON and screenshot look good).
Noah Feldman: approved after wording tweak on the troubleshooting line.
DocsBot: PR #809 merged by Kira Wong.
Kira Wong: merged. I'll post a short note in #docs and follow up with infra to monitor header usage for the next week. Thanks all! :sparkles:
